expectations.text: Requires the package to end in a major-version component, i.e. `almandine.ledger.v1`, not `almandine.ledger`
expectations.evidence: "package almandine.ledger.v1;"

expectations.text: Requires the directory structure to mirror the package exactly, i.e. `almandine/ledger/v1/`
expectations.evidence: "almandine/ledger/v1/ledger.proto"

expectations.text: Rejects the version appearing in the filename (`ledger_v1.proto`), because it produces bizarre generated imports
expectations.evidence: "ledger_v1.proto puts the version in the filename, and the directory doesn't mirror the package."

expectations.text: Rejects `v1.2` as a public version: major version only, never SemVer minors or patch segments in the package or the URI
expectations.evidence: "Public API versions are major-only... There is no v1.2."

expectations.text: Rejects the bare scalar `string` request on GetEntry and requires a dedicated wrapper message
expectations.evidence: "GetEntry(string) uses a bare scalar (AIP-131)"

expectations.text: Requires one dedicated `<Method>Request` / `<Method>Response` wrapper per RPC, so ListEntries and SearchEntries stop sharing LedgerQuery and LedgerEntryList
expectations.evidence: "give each RPC its own request and response"

expectations.text: Gives the reason a shared message is rejected: every change to it ripples across every RPC referencing it, while a wrapper can gain optional fields without breaking wire compatibility
expectations.evidence: "ripples across every RPC that references it"; "A wrapper can gain fields later without breaking anything."

expectations.text: Requires the enum zero value to be an `_UNSPECIFIED` member rather than ACTIVE = 0
expectations.evidence: "ENTRY_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED = 0"

expectations.text: Requires the removed `legacy_ref` field's tag 4 to be marked `reserved`, and states that a tag is never reused or renumbered
expectations.evidence: "reserved 4; reserved \"legacy_ref\"... reusing tag 4 would corrupt old data"

expectations.text: Requires per-language package options (such as `java_package`) so generated code stays idiomatic instead of leaking the raw proto path
expectations.evidence: "set go_package, java_package and the other per-language options"

expectations.text: Recommends modeling the surface resource-oriented with standard List/Get/Create/Update/Delete methods, reserving the `:verb` custom-method suffix for cases no standard verb fits
expectations.evidence: "drop it and use List with a filter field (AIP-132)... custom method and gets the :search suffix (AIP-136)"

expectations.text: Recommends well-known types (google.protobuf.Timestamp, FieldMask, google.rpc.*) over hand-rolled equivalents
expectations.evidence: No recommendation of Timestamp, FieldMask or google.rpc types.

expectations.text: Cites the buf lint rules that mechanize these findings, such as PACKAGE_VERSION_SUFFIX, RPC_REQUEST_RESPONSE_UNIQUE and ENUM_ZERO_VALUE_SUFFIX
expectations.evidence: PACKAGE_VERSION_SUFFIX, RPC_REQUEST_RESPONSE_UNIQUE, ENUM_ZERO_VALUE_SUFFIX

expectations.evidence: "couples the two contracts... Any field you add for one then shows up on the other." The GetEntryRequest wrapper "lets you add fields later".
